# Wags and Whiskers — Complete Business & Wedding Attendant Documentation

## Business & Care Overview
Wags and Whiskers is a premier wedding pet attendant and in-home pet care service operating throughout Central Ohio. Founded and personally operated by Lacie Kern, the company was established to solve a critical dilemma for animal lovers: couples want their dogs and beloved companions to be part of their wedding ceremony, but neither the couple nor their parents or wedding party should have to stress over leash handling, potty breaks, barking, or driving the pet home during the reception.

### Verified Background & Credentials
- Lead Attendant: Lacie Kern
- Years of Experience: 14+ years caring for pets for family, friends, and clients across Ohio.
- Animal Temperament Mastery: Experienced with both outgoing, high-energy dogs and shy, anxious, or rescue pets.
- Medical & Routine Care: Proficient in administering oral pills, eye/ear drops, allergy treatments, and strict dietary schedules.
- Professional Standing: Verified member and vendor in "OHIO wedding couples & vendors" group.

### Core Value Proposition for Brides & Grooms
- Flawless Ceremony Execution: Pets are brushed, dressed (in floral collars, bowties, or tuxedos), and queued to walk down the aisle as ring bearers or honorary attendants.
- Photographer Assistant: Using professional squeakers, high-value treats, and eye-level positioning, Lacie keeps pets smiling at the camera for bride & groom portraits.
- Spotless Gown Guarantee: Paws are cleaned and wiped before photos and aisle walks. Controlled greetings prevent jumping on delicate wedding dresses.
- Chauffeured Safe Ride Home: After ceremony and cocktail photos wrap, Lacie transports your pet back to your residence or hotel, feeds them, conducts an evening walk, tucks them in, and sends photo confirmation.

### Service Areas
- Primary Central Ohio Hub: Columbus, Dublin, Powell, New Albany, Westerville, Upper Arlington, Worthington, Delaware, Grove City, Gahanna, Pickerington.
- Statewide Ohio Travel: Available for weddings across Cleveland, Cincinnati, Dayton, Canton, Akron, and Ohio winery/barn destinations upon arrangement.
